senses.gloss: जात- + आस्थ जात- + आस्थ, adj., f. था, full of hope, Daśak. in Chr. 200, 6.
जात- + इष्टि जात- + इष्टि (vb. जन्), f. a sacrifice on the birth of a child, Vedāntas. in Chr. 202, 16.
जात- + कर्मन् जात- + कर्मन्, n. the ceremony on the birth of a child, Man. 2, 27.
जाती- + कोश जाती- + कोश, n. and m. nutmeg, Suśr. 1, 215, 5.
जतु- + गृह जतु- + गृह, n. a house painted and filled with lac and other combustible substances, MBh. 1, 313.
जतु- + गेह जतु- + गेह, n. a house painted and filled with lac and other combustible substances, MBh. 5, 1987.

जतु जतु, m. Lac, the red animal dye, MBh. 1, 5725.
 --Comp.

जातु जातु, i. e. जन् + तु, adv.
 1. Ever, MBh. 5, 7071.
 2. Perhaps, MBh. 12, 6739.
 3. Once, Kathās. 6, 89.
 4. With preceding न, Never, Man. 2, 94.
 5. With preceding न, and following चिद्, Nevermore, never, MBh. 1, 1936.
जत्रु जत्रु, m. and n. The collarbone, MBh. 3, 713.

जातक जात + क, (vb. जन्)
 I. m. A [] son, Man. 9, 143 (in जार-, Begotten by an adulterer).
 II. n.
 1. A ceremony on the birth of a child, MBh. 1, 949.
 2. Astrological calculation of a nativity, Bhāg. P. 1, 12, 13.
जातरूपमय जात-रूप + मय, adj., f. यी, Golden, Rām. 3, 48, 13.

जातवेदस् जात-वेदस्, and जातवेद जातवेद (Bhāg. P. 5, 7, 13), m.
 1. The producer of wealth(?), Chr. 289, 1 = Rigv. i. 50, 1.
 2. Fire, Bhāg. P. 5, 10, 5.
जातवेदसी जातवेदसी, i. e. जातवेदस् + अ + ई, f. A name of Durgā, MBh. 6, 802.

जाति जाति, i. e. जन् + ति, f.
 1. Birth, Man. 2, 148.
 2. Existence, life, Man. 4, 148.
 3. State, Man. 3, 15.
 4. Tribe, Man. 1, 118.
 5. Kind, genus, MBh. 4, 45; Pañc. 203, 3.
 6. Species, Man. 1, 48.
 7. Also जाती जाती, Great flowered jasmine, Hariv. 7891. जाती जाती, also The nutmeg-tree, Suśr. 1, 132, 20; nutmeg.
 --Comp.
 --Cf. Lat. gens; A.S. cynd; Engl. kind.

जाती जाती, see जाति
 7.
जातिमन्त् जाति + मन्त्, adj., f. मती, High-born, Rām. 2, 75, 21 Gorr.
जातिस्मरता जाति-स्मर + ता, f., and
जातिस्मरत्व जाति-स्मर + त्व, n. Remembrance of a former existence, MBh. 3, 160; 8107.

ऽजातीय -जातीय, i. e. जाति + ईय, adj. Belonging to a caste, Man. 11, 162; or kind, Pañc. 190, 21; or genus, Pañc. 76, 8.
 --Comp.
जातुष जातुष, i. e. जतुस् (= जतु) + अ, adj., f. षी, Made of lac, Pañc. i. d. 120; painted with lac, MBh. 1, 151.

जात्य जात्य, i. e. जाति + य, adj.
 1. Belonging to a tribe, Rām. 2, 50, 18.
 2. Belonging to a family, Man. 10, 5.
 3. Of a noble race, Rām. 2, 45, 14.
 4. True, Rām. 2, 9, 40. स्व-, adj. Belonging to one's own species, Pañc. 71, 11.
जात-गीत-दिदृक्ष जात-गीत-दिदृक्ष, adj., f. षा, desirous to see the singer, Rājat. 5, 357.
जाति- + धर्म जाति- + धर्म, m. the customs of tribes, Man. 1, 118.
जाति- + भ्रंश जाति- + भ्रंश, m. Loss of caste, Man. 11, 67.
जतु- + मणि जतु- + मणि, m. a mole, Suśr. 1, 92, 3.
जात- + मात्र जात- + मात्र, adj., f. रा, just born, immediately after one's birth or beginning, Daśak. in Chr. 186, 18; Pañc. i. d. 264.
जाति- + मात्र जाति- + मात्र, n. nothing but birth, Man. 8, 20.
जतु- + वेश्मन् जतु- + वेश्मन्, m. a house, constructed of shell-lac, Johns. Sel. 55, 143.
जात-रूप-शिल जात-रूप-शिल, m. the name of a (golden) mountain, Rām. 4, 14, 52.
जाति- + स्मर जाति- + स्मर, adj., f. रा, one who remembers or knows his former existences, MBh. 3, 8180.
जाति- + स्मरण जाति- + स्मरण, n. Remembering one's former existences, MBh. 12, 6256.
